chapter_title: Concerning the Fourteen Vehicles that Jesus has boarded
chapter_note: Clear two-part structure: paragraphs 2-8 contain a systematic ten-vehicle cosmic descent teaching (the substrate core), while paragraphs 9-10 are later editorial additions extending the pattern to institutional content and closing with a beatitude. The ten vehicles map a coherent cosmological descent sequence: from the light ship and Ambassador, through the ship of the First Man and Pillar of Glory, through the Call and Answer (summons/obedience), and finally through the five light elements (air, wind, light, water, fire). Gardner notes this reverses the ascent order familiar from Ch. 71, confirming its systematic character. The editorial seam at paragraph 9 is textbook: 'After he had assumed these ten, he came and manifested in the flesh. He chose the holy church in four vehicles.' — the editor mimics the enumeration pattern but applies it to Manichaean community categories. Editorial fatigue data strongly supports this division.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Pure formulaic opening: 'Once again, the Light-Man speaks to the congregation that is sitting in front of him.' No substantive cosmological question — just attribution formula. 'Light-Man' is a variant of 'enlightener'; 'congregation sitting in front of him' is session-setting.

paragraphs.core_text: When Jesus the Son of Greatness came to these worlds, at the time that he unveiled the greatness, he boarded ten vehicles. He journeyed in the universe by them.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Sets up the systematic ten-vehicle enumeration. 'Jesus the Son of Greatness' functions as a cosmic entity name within the system — the descending redeemer figure. Crucially says TEN vehicles, not fourteen — the fourteen-count is the editor's extension. Both sides stay in the cosmic system: cosmic figure → cosmic descent through cosmic vehicles. No institutional or contemporary reference.

paragraphs.core_text: The first vehicle is the light ship, since he received instructions from the Ambassador there.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Enumeration unit #1. 'Light ship' and 'the Ambassador' (the Third Messenger) are cosmic entities/locations. The cosmic figure receives instructions at his first station. Substrate score 26.67 confirms cosmological vocabulary density.

paragraphs.core_text: ⟨p.37⟩ The second carriage is the ship of the First Man, since his dwelling is established there.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Enumeration unit #2. 'Ship of the First Man' — cosmic vessel of a cosmic entity. The descent continues through cosmic stations. Manuscript page marker preserved.

paragraphs.core_text: The third is the Pillar of Glory, the Perfect Man, since he shone forth there. He came below, he appeared in the world.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Enumeration unit #3. 'Pillar of Glory' and 'Perfect Man' are cosmic entities. 'He came below, he appeared in the world' describes cosmic descent into the lower cosmos, not historical incarnation — it stays within the cosmological system. High substrate score (34.78).

paragraphs.core_text: The fourth is the summons that he clothed upon his body. The fifth is the obedience that he swathed upon the summons.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Enumeration units #4-5. 'Summons' (the Call) and 'obedience' (the Answer) are cosmic elements in the Manichaean cosmological system — the Call that awakens and the Response. 'Clothed upon' and 'swathed upon' are the assumption/vestment formulas characteristic of the substrate. Both sides stay in the cosmic system.

paragraphs.core_text: The sixth is the living air, and since he assumed it too, he received anointment there. The seventh is the living wind that blows. The eighth is the light that illuminates. The ninth is the living water. The tenth is the living fire that is above them all.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Enumeration units #6-10: the five light elements (air, wind, light, water, fire). This is the core of the substrate — systematic five-element nomenclature mapped as cosmic vehicles. Gardner notes this reverses the ascent order from Ch. 71. Highest substrate score in the chapter (25.0). 'Living fire that is above them all' establishes hierarchical ordering within the elements.

paragraphs.core_text: He was journeying in these ten carriages among all the orders and all the [...], those above and those below.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Summary of the ten-vehicle cosmic descent. 'All the orders... those above and those below' maps the cosmic hierarchy traversed. Lacuna [...] preserved. This closes the substrate teaching — the ten cosmic stations are complete.

EDITORIAL SEAM. The ten-vehicle cosmic teaching is complete at paragraph 8. The editor now extends the enumeration pattern to institutional content: 'He chose the holy church in four vehicles' — holy brothers, pure sisters, male catechumens, female catechumens. Classic pattern mimicry: the editor imitates the enumeration syntax ('One is... The second is... The third is... The fourth is...') but applies it to Manichaean community categories. 'Manifested in the flesh' is the bridge phrase. Institutional vocabulary: 'holy church,' 'catechumens,' 'sons of the faith,' 'daughters of the light and truth.' One side of the mapping now reaches outside the cosmic system into community structure.

Devotional closure merging both layers: 'ten carriages in the zone, and the other four that are in the flesh, they complete and make fourteen.' This summary was written by the same editorial hand that added paragraph 9 — it treats the combined count as unified teaching. Soteriological summary ('made alive, redeemed, given victory') and classic beatitude formula ('Blessed is he who will know these mysteries') confirm exhortation layer. Exhortation score 10.1 in the data. This wraps the chapter with devotional closure.
